instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: Stage 2 synthesis: A 65-year-old man with baseline stage 3a CKD has had 72 hours of vomiting and profuse watery diarrhea during a norovirus outbreak. After 1,500 mL IV fluid, urine output remains about 0.14 mL/kg/hr. Creatinine has risen from a baseline of 1.4 to 4.5 mg/dL. Admission urine was concentrated with urine sodium 8 mEq/L and FENa 0.4%, and bladder scan was 40 mL. Potassium is now 6.4 mEq/L with persistent peaked T waves, PR prolongation to 0.24 seconds, and QRS widening to 0.12 seconds. Select the most likely condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.
